# The mbox input stream is blocking and does not implement ReadSegments

MboxMsgInputStream reports IsNonBlocking=false and returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED from ReadSegments. Read serializes state and pumps data as needed; it is not an asynchronous stream just because MboxScanner uses an input-stream pump. Preserve the separate stream and scanner contracts when choosing callers or tests. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/base/src.
